service.description: Import a data set, here (a ServiceJob runs it in the background). A run's scope is its source key (every data set sharing the sourceKey, which must share one format) and its country. Preflight, refused with an error and no run: the set registered and enabled; for a set downloaded from its URL, outside requests allowed (maps@external-requests) and no location given; for an operator's file (a set with no URL), a countryGeoId and a location under dbresource://moqui/maps/import/, runtime://import/ or the user's own uploads; the license acknowledged by an administrator (licenseAckUserId); no run of the same scope in progress (one whose row has not changed for an hour is taken as abandoned and marked failed, and a live one so marked stops at its next check). countryGeoId is needed for a set read a country at a time and must be its coverage for a set with one. A run downloads from the registered host (never an internal address) to runtime/tmp/geo-import as it arrives, within maps@import-max-bytes, conditionally on the edition in use's ETag and Last-Modified (an unchanged source ends the run GdiUnchanged); the edition in use is the scope's last completed run, and none while the source key has no rows in date there (after a Remove), so such a run fetches whole. It reads the whole file (a zip member within maps@import-max-bytes and a ratio limit, lines within 64 KB), checking each row's country, code shape (leading zeros kept, a partial code a declared prefix), computed IDs, coordinates and duplicates, writing nothing; refuses a file with no row to load, or with fewer than 80% of the edition in use's rows unless forced; loads in batches of 2,000 codes, a transaction each, creating or updating by computed ID and leaving unchanged rows alone, the counts written and the cancel flag read between batches. Only after a whole load, it end-dates (thruDate) what this source key owns in the run's country that the new edition does not have: its postal codes (but one another source still has a point for), place names and point associations, a row passed over for another fault keeping its code when the code could be read. The run (GdiCompleted, with its edition) is then the edition in use, and the postal lookup cache is cleared. A run never changes a row another source key owns, a code made by hand (no sourceKey), a user-confirmed point or a record's own location; it revives a code another source key owns and retired when this edition has it (the code stays that source's). Where two sources have a code each writes its own point, and the data set's priority makes the active one. Rejected rows go to the error file (dbresource://moqui/maps/geo-import/(userId)/(geoDataImportId)/errors.csv, as an ETL run's: the first 10,000, and how many more), the first 100 in errors; a failed run's errorLocation names the step. geoDataImportId runs a pending run (GdiPending, made by the screen or job that starts it), whose own data set and country are used. A ServiceJob with no user signed in names the user to run as in runAsUserId, a ServiceJobUser of the job who added themselves.

parameter.name: force
parameter.description: Fetch whatever the edition in use, and accept a file with far fewer rows than it

parameter.name: runAsUserId
parameter.description: For a ServiceJob run with no user signed in: the user to run as, a ServiceJobUser of the job who added themselves

service.description: Ask a run to stop: a pending run is cancelled at once; a running one reads the request between its steps and batches and ends GdiCancelled with nothing retired, the rows of the batches it loaded kept and the edition in use unchanged. Refused for a run that has ended.

Remove what a data set's source key owns, for countryGeoId (needed for a set read a country at a time; every country for a set with none), in one transaction: its place names and point associations, then each point, postal code and county, place or city Geo it made that no row of any entity refers to (from the entity model's relationships to Geo, GeoPoint and GeoPostalCode: another source's points and place names, an address, a group); the rest are end-dated. A user-confirmed point stays, with its association, and keeps its Geo; a record's own location is left alone. For the ZCTA-to-county set, its county-to-code links are deleted; a set of countries or divisions is refused, those rows being shared. Refused while an import of the source key and country is in progress. rowsDeleted and rowsRetired count rows.
